meta.name: isles_of_war
meta.prompt: A pirate island and a unicorn island, at war.

tokens.event_direction: pirate corsairs and unicorn defenders facing off across the water with shore batteries and naval lines
tokens.conflict: pirate corsairs vs enchanted unicorn sanctuary

programs.brief: A towering crystalline unicorn statue rearing on marble hooves, looking out across the sea toward the pirate haven, radiating arcane energy.
A heavily armed pirate war galleon anchored offshore, black timber hull with three tiers of gunports bristling with iron cannons pointed at the unicorn island.
A reinforced defensive coastal gun redoubt with sandbag revetments, powder kegs, and a heavy brass cannon aimed across the water.
